## Install

Unzip `skrivli-{{VERSION}}-windows-x64.zip` anywhere and run `skrivli.exe`. There is no installer.

## Windows SmartScreen

Windows may say it protected your PC. Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. The app is not code-signed yet.

## Models

Transcription models are a separate download inside the app. They are not part of the ZIP.
